What the records look like

Five templates for the records we hand over. They show the structure and the acceptance questions; they contain no project data. Project records are shared with the owner, and with others only with the owner's permission.

Download all five as PDFHow the turnover package is structured
1. Factory acceptance test record2. Turnover package index3. System boundary diagram4. Flow-balance test record, with its conditions5. Non-conformance and re-test log
Template · not a project record

1. Factory acceptance test record

One sheet per prefabricated assembly (skid, rack manifold or CDU), completed at the factory before release. Gate 1 of commissioning.

ProjectAssembly and serialDrawing and revisionDateTested byWitnessed by
TestReferenceAcceptance criterionResultPass / fail
Hydrostatic pressure testProcedure ref.Test pressure ___ kPa held ___ min; no visible leak; pressure decay within ___ %
Leak test of joints and QDsProcedure ref.No weep at test pressure; method stated (bubble, tracer gas or decay)
Cleanliness of wetted surfacesSample ref.Particle count at or below the agreed class, verified by sample
Torque of threaded and flanged jointsTorque table ref.All joints to table; wrench calibration certificate attached
Quick-disconnect registerRegister ref.Every QD listed by serial with mate cycles made during factory testing
Controls function checkChecklist ref.Pump staging, valve travel and sensor readings as specified
Document checkIndex ref.Drawings at stated revision, material certificates, test sheets signed

3. System boundary diagram

Drawn for each project, so every party can see where its responsibility starts and stops. The six boundaries follow the thermal path, numbered from the facility inward: B1 facility water interface to B6 cold plate and chip.

B1Facility water interfaceFacility mechanical contractorRecord owner: ______
B2Heat rejection and reuseHeat-rejection vendor or heat buyerRecord owner: ______
B3CDU and secondary loopCDU maker, integratorRecord owner: ______
B4Rack manifold and quick disconnectsRack integrator, QD supplierRecord owner: ______
B5Hoses, crimps and fittingsHose assembler, rack integratorRecord owner: ______
B6Cold plate and chipCold-plate maker, server OEMRecord owner: ______
Template · not a project record

4. Flow-balance test record, with its conditions

A reading without its conditions cannot be compared with anything. The conditions are recorded with the results. Gate 3 of commissioning.

5. Non-conformance and re-test log

Every finding is raised, fixed, re-tested and closed in writing. Open items at handover are listed, owned and dated, and accepted by the owner. Gate 4 of commissioning.
